criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?
The transition state-change logic skips the actual state change when the destination is None (internal transition), rather than always changing state or calling state lookup with None.
criteria.contract_ref: Transition.execute / Known pitfalls: Internal transitions (dest is None)

criteria.text: Condition checking compares the predicate's boolean result against the condition's target value (so negative/'unless' conditions with target=False work), not merely returning the raw truthiness of the predicate.
criteria.contract_ref: Condition.check / Known pitfalls: Condition target polarity

criteria.text: Callback/condition invocation branches on the send_event setting: passing the single EventData object when send_event is enabled and unpacking args/kwargs when it is disabled, rather than using one calling convention unconditionally.
criteria.contract_ref: Condition.check / Machine.callbacks / Known pitfalls: send_event branching

criteria.text: The state change performs exit of the source state, then sets the model's new state, then enters the destination state (exit-before-enter ordering), rather than entering before exiting or omitting either step.
criteria.contract_ref: Transition._change_state / Solution decomposition: State change ordering

criteria.text: After setting the model's new state and before entering the destination, the EventData's state reference is refreshed to the new state so enter/final logic reads the current (not stale) state.
criteria.contract_ref: Known pitfalls: EventData refresh after state change

criteria.text: When the destination state is a final state, the machine's on_final callbacks are fired as part of completing the state change.
Transition.execute evaluates the transition's conditions and returns False without performing the state change when any condition fails, only proceeding to the state change when all conditions pass.

Transition.execute runs the callback phases in order: prepare, then before (machine before_state_change plus transition before), then the state change, then after (transition after plus machine after_state_change).

State name/value handling distinguishes enum members from strings: the name property yields the enum member's .name for enum states and the raw string for string states, while value returns the underlying stored object.
